_comment: 复制为 config.json 后按本机情况修改。留空 = 用内置默认（python 用当前解释器；tasks_json/status_json 由 zotero_data_dir / work_base 推导）。路径支持 ~ 展开，分隔符 / 或 \ 均可。环境变量优先级最高，可覆盖任意字段。
notes: Translation standard: sentence-by-sentence fidelity to the English source; no min/max character limits. Env: ZOTERO_DATA_DIR, ZOTERO_PYTHON, ZOTERO_WORK_BASE, ZOTERO_TASKS_JSON, ZOTERO_STATUS_JSON
